story.label: UNDOCKED: Daniela Kapoor, Sunday night
story.angle: UNDOCKED episode: Daniela Kapoor, Sunday night. Standings: Marguerite Kimball-Ostrow leads the board — rank #1, 49.08 achievement points, 0 credits, 2 cycle(s) led, current streak 2. In the chair: Daniela Kapoor — Teacher.
facts: Daniela Kapoor's Sunday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Electra, Mimosa, Ross 154, Arcturus, Timberline and Maplevale; mined 8 copper ore, 15 iron ore and 1 antimatter containment cell; earned Wanderer (8 points), Maiden Jump (5 points), Voyager I (3.2 points), The Truth Is Out There (2.5 points), Cartographer (2.4 points), Chronicler (1.2 points), Voyager II (0.8 points), Prospector I (0.02 points), Far Traveler (0.01 points) and Jump Master (0.01 points); came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.
